issue.title: PyJWT.decode_complete() method changing provided options object

fix.message:
Don't mutate options dictionary in .decode_complete() (#743)

Fixes #679

selection_notes: A Flask-Login candidate could not be established from its referenced PR. PyJWT #679 was the first selected and only localized case. Selection was completed before any Agent run.
preparation_notes: First archive export failed byte validation due to Git for Windows CRLF conversion before analyze() was called. A fresh snapshot with core.autocrlf=false passed validation; one primary Agent run followed.
audit_notes: Search audit replays individual read-only search tools after the raw result was saved; it does not invoke analyze() or alter candidate ranks. Before/after behavioral reproduction was also performed after scoring.
